review.why: Keep a new Expo project organized so routes, screen code and server helpers have clear boundaries.
review.summary: Defines a starting layout for new Expo Router apps, with route-only directories, reusable components, screen modules and platform-specific files.
strengths: Separates routes, shared code and server-only helpers.
Provides a concrete folder tree and extraction rules.
cautions: A starting convention for new Expo projects, not a required migration.
Backend placement and platform variants still need project-specific review.
No generated app or native build was run in this review.
